name: unlock_car_group
comment: (unlock id) the part group of an id: 0..9 by id range below 0x79; above: 0..12 or -1 (menu/garage.rs group)

name: unlock_new_part
comment: (unlock id) id of a part the career car can now unlock ("new"); 0 none; case group 5 draws rand_table

name: unlock_part_installed
comment: (unlock id) 1 when the career car has exactly this part level installed

name: unlock_mark_owned
comment: (unlock id) sets the owned bit of a table id (car extras / profile +0xF5) or the car bit in profile +0x12

name: garage_part_levels
comment: (unlock id; out[4]) the four 2-bit levels of the group's byte in the working copy; returns their sum

name: garage_part_level
comment: (unlock id) the working copy's level byte of the id's group

name: garage_set_part_level
comment: (unlock id; reload) writes the working copy's level; reloads the atlas and palette by group

name: car_stat_bars
comment: (car; out base[3]; out with parts[3]) base speed/accel/handling from 0x7F0BD8+0x52 plus the installed parts' weights (0x7E46EC) capped at 100

name: garage_rating
comment: () the working copy's build rating (100 plus the parts' shares)

name: district_completion_text
comment: (buffer; zone) completion percent of a district's events as "N%" (a space before % in French and Italian)
